brief:
Al-Shifa Medical Complex director Mohammed Abu Salmiya, a former detainee in Israeli prisons, warned Shehab Wire of a serious threat to the life of detained doctor Hussam Abu Safiya, 53, who is held in Israeli custody. Abu Salmiya drew on his own experience as a previous prisoner when issuing the warning about the conditions the physician faces.

The alert comes as concern grows over the welfare of medical professionals detained during Israel's military operations in Gaza. Abu Safiya, a practicing physician, has been held in custody for an extended period, and Abu Salmiya's warning underscores the dangers medical workers say they face while imprisoned.

title: Shifa Hospital director warns of danger to detained physician Abu Safiya.
